youtube.title: Lakshmi ji ne Vishnu ko hi kyun chuna? 🪔 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Devta aur asur jab Samudra Manthan kar rahe the, tab kshir sagar se kamal par virajman Goddess Lakshmi prakat huin. Sabhi unhe pane ko aatur the, par unhone kisi ko nahi dekha.

Lakshmi ji ne apne haath mein kamal ki mala li aur sabko parakh kar, shaant aur sarv-guna sampann Bhagwan Vishnu ke gale mein mala daal di. Tabhi se woh unke vaksh par vaas karti hain. Diwali par unki puja isi liye hoti hai.

Katha ka strot: Bhagavata Purana, Skandh 8, Adhyay 8.
